instruction: Design a system that combines the 100-bit binary multiplier from problem 1 with the 4-to-1 multiplexer from problem 2. The system should include an additional functional module that takes in the 200-bit product from the multiplier and the output from the multiplexer, and outputs a final 8-bit value by adding the two inputs together. The multiplexer should select one of its four inputs based on a 2-bit select input. The multiplier should output its 200-bit product to the functional module. The final output should be the 8-bit sum of the product and the selected input from the multiplexer.
